designationHistory.indexText: President Wilson proclaimed the boundaries of the Pisgah National Forest in North Carolina on lands bought under the Weeks Act.
designationHistory.note: The proclamation recites that the Secretary of Agriculture had designated these lands the Pisgah National Forest on Sept. 29, 1916 under section 11 of the Weeks Act; that secretarial designation was not separately checked.
